summary: Both editions were independently reviewed against all ten paragraphs of the selected Greek source; the simplified edition was also compared with the standard. No concrete fidelity defect was identified. Both preserve the prayer’s requests and purposes, speaker distinctions, warnings, measurements, faith genitive, destructive capacity, restrictive movement statements, temporal boundary, and four color groups. The opening supplied noun “vision” is explicitly disclosed as editorial completion. Servant and contextual repentance terminology follow current policy. The notes distinguish selected readings from alternatives, first hands from corrections, and preserved wording from restorations and conjectures, consistently with the supplied bounded project reports. Acceptance concerns the supplied texts and disclosures only; it does not authenticate unseen images, certify external editions, establish a unique interpretation, or constitute exhaustive scholarly collation.
